definitions.explanation: A room, building, or space used for storing items that are not frequently used.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{道具|どうぐ}は{物置|ものお}きにしまってある。
examples.english: Old tools are stored in the shed.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}に{物置|ものお}きを{建|た}てた。
examples.english: I built a storage shed in the garden.

examples.japanese: {物置|ものお}きを{整理|せいり}したら{昔|むかし}のアルバムが{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: When I organized the storeroom, I found old photo albums.

examples.japanese: {使|つか}わなくなった{自転車|じてんしゃ}を{物置|ものお}きにしまった。
examples.english: I put the bicycle I stopped using in the storage shed.

examples.japanese: {物置|ものお}きがいっぱいで、もう{何|なに}も{入|はい}らない。
examples.english: The storage shed is full and nothing more can fit.

notes:
FORMS:
{物|もの} (things) + {置|お}き (placing) = a place for putting things

TYPES:
- {屋外|おくがい}{物置|ものお}き - outdoor storage shed
- {屋内|おくない}{物置|ものお}き - indoor storeroom
- {庭|にわ}の{物置|ものお}き - garden shed

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {物置|ものお}きにしまう (to store in the shed)
- {物置|ものお}きを{整理|せいり}する (to organize the storage)
- {物置|ものお}きを{建|た}てる (to build a shed)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {倉庫|そうこ} - warehouse (larger, commercial)
- {納戸|なんど} - storage closet (inside a house)
- {蔵|くら} - traditional storehouse
